SECTION 7 SIMPLE TALK:

**7.1 Both sides protect each other.** If outsider sue you because I mess up, I pay. If outsider sue me because you mess up, you pay. Cover: broken promises, big-bad acts, my stuff steal someone idea. BUT me not pay if you change my stuff, mix my stuff with other stuff, or use my stuff wrong way.

**7.2 How protect work.** You get sued? Tell me fast. Let me handle fight. I can settle, but not make you admit fault or do weird thing without you say yes. You help me, I pay you back.

**7.3 Money cap.** Normal mess-ups: no pay for lost profit, lost data, lost good name, or side-damage. Max pay = bigger of (money you pay me last 12 moons) OR ($100,000). BUT no cap when: protect duty (7.1), spill secrets, big-bad acts, or steal other side idea.

---

KEY WORDS PLAIN TALK:

- **Indemnify** = I pay your legal bill and damage cost when trouble come.
- **Hold harmless** = You not on hook, I take hit.
- **Defend** = I hire lawyer, fight case for you.
- **Third-party claim** = Outsider (not us two) come sue.
- **Losses** = All bad money stuff: fines, court cost, lawyer fee, damage pay.
- **Breach** = Break promise in deal.
- **Representation/warranty/covenant** = Promise you make in deal.
- **Gross negligence** = Way more sloppy than normal sloppy. Reckless.
- **Willful misconduct** = Bad thing done on purpose.
- **Infringe/misappropriate IP** = Steal or use someone patent, copyright, trademark, secret.
- **Deliverables** = Stuff one side make and hand over.
- **Tender sole control** = Hand full power over lawsuit to other side.
- **Materially prejudiced** = Real harm from late notice.
- **Indirect/consequential/incidental damages** = Ripple-effect bad stuff, not direct hit.
- **Punitive/exemplary damages** = Extra pay court add to punish.
- **Lost profits/revenue/goodwill/data** = Money not made, reputation drop, info gone.
- **Cap on liability** = Top limit on money owed.
- **Carve-outs** = Special case where cap not apply. Here: indemnify duty, secret leak, big-bad acts, IP steal.

BIG PICTURE: Deal say both share risk fair. Small mistake = small pay (capped). Big mistake or break promise = full pay, no cap.
